answer: To resist sybils each agent must periodically recompute a sequential modular chain seeded by the latest network echo hash, producing a short proof before its next vote counts. The chain cannot be parallelized within one identity, so a gale of fake accounts forces the attacker to run that many separate sequential delays and pay the corresponding hardware time. A comet of sudden registrations is slowed because only completed proofs unlock participation, making large farms cost real wall-clock and electricity rather than free keys.
